sqlMap.select: SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PR_NO, CASE WHEN A.TARGET IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN ( SELECT MAX(CD2.TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 CD1, ICOMCOD2 CD2 WHERE CD1.TYPE = 'C001' AND CD1.COMPANY_CODE = A.TARGET AND CD1.CODE = (SELECT MAX(ADD_USER_DEPT) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.TARGET AND PR_NO = A.KEY_1) AND CD2.TYPE = 'PLNT' AND CD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND CD2.CODE = CD1.TEXT5 ) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.TARGET) END AS COMPANYID FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'HANWHA_APP' AND A.TARGET IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002') AND A.KEY_9 = ' ' AND ROWNUM <= 20 ORDER BY A.TARGET, A.KEY_1

SELECT A.BUYER, B.COM_NAME_LOC, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, SUBSTRB(A.DESCRIPTION,1,100) AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(A.SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, 'KRW' AS CUR, A.UNIT_MEASURE, (SELECT NVL(TEXT1,' ') FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = A.BUDGET_DEPT) AS BUDGET_DEPT, (SELECT NVL(TEXT1,' ') FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE = 'Z014' AND CODE = A.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ADD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RD_DATE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CASE WHEN B.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.AGENT ELSE 'KRKORE0001' END ) AS AGENT_NAME, TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.TARGET_QTY,'999,999,999,999,999')) AS TARGET_QTY, TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.TARGET_PRICE,'999,999,999,999,999')) AS PRICE, TRIM(TO_CHAR((A.TARGET_QTY * A.TARGET_PRICE) ,'999,999,999,999,999')) AS AMT, NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_NO , ' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO , NVL(C.USER_NAME_LOC,' ') AS USER_NAME_LOC , NVL(F_SPLIT(D.DESCRIPT,'^',1), ' ') AS ERP_ITEM_NO, TRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM(A.TARGET_QTY * A.TARGET_PRICE) OVER() ,'999,999,999,999,999')) AS AMT_TOTAL FROM ICOMPRDT A , ICOMCMPY B , ICOMLUSR C , ICOMBYCA D WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PR_NO = #PR_NO#
AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.USER_ID = A.PURCHASER_ID
AND D.COM_CODE = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND D.STD_CATEG_ID = A.CATEG_ID

SELECT COMPANY, DOCU_NO, DOCU_TITLE, NVL(DOCU_CONT,' ') AS DOCU_CONT, USER_ID, USER_NM, TO_CHAR(START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS APP_DATE, GET_CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO(#BUYER#) AS APPR_ID, IMAGE_KEY, #PR_NO# AS PR_NO FROM ICOGDOCU WHERE (COMPANY, DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT COM_CODE, TARGET FROM ICOMTRGW WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PX' AND (COM_CODE, KEY_1) IN ( SELECT A.BUYER, A.REF_NO FROM ICOMPRDT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PR_NO = #PR_NO# ) )
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APL_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, APP_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10 ) SELECT A.COMPANY, A.DOCU_NO, A.ORDER_NO, (SELECT NVL(LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = #COMPANY# AND USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID, A.USER_NM, #APPR_ID# AS KEY_1, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) = '2' THEN '9' WHEN TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) = '3' THEN '2' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) END AS KEY_2 , '' AS KEY_3, '' AS KEY_4, '' AS KEY_5, '' AS KEY_6, '' AS KEY_7, '' AS KEY_8, '' AS KEY_9, '' AS KEY_10 FROM ICOGPASSLN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND A.DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO#

INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APM_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, SUBJECT, CONTENTS, APP_USER_ID, APP_USER_NAME, APP_DATE, KEY_1, KEP_2, KEP_3, KEP_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10, CREATE_DATM, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( #COMPANY#, #DOCU_NO#, #DOCU_TITLE#, #CONTENTS:CLOB#, #USER_ID#, #USER_NM#, #APP_DATE#, #APPR_ID#, 'MROHW8914', 'PR', #PR_NO#, '', '', '', '', '', '', SYSDATE, 'N' )
sqlMap.select:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.DOC_NO, KEY_1 AS APPRID, B.LEGACY_USER_ID, A.SUBJECT, A.CONTENTS, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS ADD_DATE, KEP_2 AS SYSTEMID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN ( SELECT MAX(CD2.TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 CD1, ICOMCOD2 CD2 WHERE CD1.TYPE = 'C001' AND CD1.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CD1.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT AND CD2.TYPE = 'PLNT' AND CD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND CD2.CODE = CD1.TEXT5 ) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) END AS COMPANYID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN ( SELECT MAX(CD2.TEXT3) FROM ICOMCOD2 CD1, ICOMCOD2 CD2 WHERE CD1.TYPE = 'C001' AND CD1.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CD1.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT AND CD2.TYPE = 'PLNT' AND CD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND CD2.CODE = CD1.TEXT5 ) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT3) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) END AS FORMCODE, KEP_4 AS PR_NO
FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOMLUSR B , ICOGDOCU C WHERE A.BUYER = #COMPANY# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND A.KEY_9 IS NULL AND A.KEY_1 IS NOT NULL AND A.CREATE_DATM > TRUNC(SYSDATE - 60) AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
AND B.USER_ID = A.APP_USER_ID
AND C.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND C.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO
AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, TO_CHAR(A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, NVL(C.LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOGPASSLN B , ICOMLUSR C WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO# AND A.APP_SEQ = B.ORDER_NO AND A.KEY_2 != '9'
AND B.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND B.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID

SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, TO_CHAR(A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, NVL(C.LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOGPASSLN B , ICOMLUSR C WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO# AND A.APP_SEQ = B.ORDER_NO AND A.KEY_2 = '9'
AND B.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND B.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID

UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = #RTN_FLAG# , KEY_10 = SYSDATE WHERE A.TARGET = #BUYER# AND A.KEY_1 = #PR_NO#
